project_type: Monorepo: Bun runtime, React 19 client + Hono/Bun server, shared TypeScript DTOs. Client: Vite 8.3 + Tailwind CSS 4, motion/react 11.15 for animations. Server: Hono web framework, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Zod validation.
build_system: Bun with npm-compatible workspace structure. Client: `bun run dev` (Vite, proxies /api/v1 to localhost:3000), `bun run build` (tsc + vite build), `bun run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit). Server: `bun run dev`, `bun run seed` (database initialization). Biome for linting.
verification_instructions: Start dev server: `bun run dev` from client/. Navigate to http://localhost:5173/projects. Verify: (1) 4 projects render in Bento Grid with cascade animation, (2) featured filter button shows Lucide Star icon, toggle shows 3 featured / 1 unfeatured, (3) tech tags display with correct icon + color, (4) card hover: border amber, shadow, scale 1.02; featured star pulses, (5) metadata icons on detail page show Calendar/Code/ExternalLink, (6) responsive at 390px: no overflow, icons visible 14-16px, tap targets 44px+, (7) console clean (no Lucide warnings), (8) keyboard navigation works (Tab, visible focus rings). Run `bun run build` and `bun run typecheck` — both pass with 0 errors.
environment_constraints: Dev server runs at http://localhost:5173 (Vite default). API proxy to http://localhost:3000 (Hono server, must run separately). No local environment variables required for icon system (design tokens in globals.css via Tailwind @theme). Workspace paths use forward slashes; PowerShell paths require backslash conversion (git commands use -C flag).
contribution_requirements: Follow design system (steering/design-system.md): dark mode, Warm Charcoal (#0C0A09) + Burnt Amber (#F59E0B) theme, Lexend + JetBrains Mono typography, Lucide icons. Anti-slop compliance: every icon conveys info (not decoration), motion 150-200ms hover + 300ms cascade, respect prefers-reduced-motion. All interactive elements keyboard accessible (aria-labels on icon-only buttons, focus-visible outlines). Code: type-safe TypeScript, tree-shake Lucide imports individually. No breaking changes to existing components; use composition (new components + incremental updates).
key_patterns: Component structure: UI atoms in src/components/ui/ (Button, Badge, etc.); utilities in src/lib/ (cn, slugify, utils); page logic in src/pages/. Motion uses motion/react (domMax pre-loaded). Tailwind theme tokens (@theme) in globals.css map to CSS custom properties (--color-*). Existing color utilities (e.g., 'text-accent', 'bg-surface') rely on @theme tokens; tech colors (Blue, Green, Yellow, etc.) use Tailwind defaults or extended palette. Featured filter & category labels already exist in constants.ts (CATEGORY_LABELS). Seed projects have is_featured boolean, category enum, tech_stack array.
relevant_files: server/src/db/seed.ts (confirms is_featured field, 3 featured projects, tech_stack structure)
directory_structure: Worktree root: `.worktrees/icon-system-motion/` with `client/` and `server/`. Client structure: `src/components/` (bento/, form/, layout/, markdown/, motion/, projects/, ui/), `src/pages/` (admin/, HomePage.tsx, ProjectDetailPage.tsx, ProjectsPage.tsx, NotFoundPage.tsx), `src/lib/` (utilities), `src/styles/globals.css` (Tailwind theme), `src/types/api.ts` (re-exports from shared), `src/config/constants.ts` (labels, routes, transitions). Server structure: `src/db/` (schema, seed), `src/shared/dto.ts` (shared types), routes, services.
